_source: PRELIMINARY. Outer boundary from the Prince George's County parcel layer (PGAtlas Property/MapServer/15), compiled from tax maps — NOT a boundary survey and NOT a plat of record. Lot lines and the street are those of the 2023 "Wheeler Rd Subdivision Layout" sheet, digitised at 1" = 30' and fitted to the county parcel (rms 5 ft), with the alley widened to a street and the west entrance finished as a turnaround. A Maryland licensed surveyor must establish the boundary before any plat is prepared.
